verdict.rationale: Pomelo publishes an API reference covering core operations: creating digital accounts, authorizing and adjusting transactions, and receiving reversals and refunds through an adjustments endpoint. That shows the product can be driven programmatically through its own documented API. However, probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and the evidence pack lacks endpoint-level detail such as authentication, request/response schemas, and public self-serve access. Missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec, documented auth and access model for public use, endpoint-level reference detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Crea cuentas digitales y obtén información sobre sus actividades.
